title: Data principal raises an access request from My requests

preconditions: The portal is running at http://localhost:3001 and Anjali Verma (subject@cmp.local / +91 90000 00001) can sign in to it.

test_data: What are you asking for: Access (s.11)
About: Everything you hold about me
Your request: Please give me a summary of all the personal data you hold about me and who it was shared with.
Note the reference shown (called RR-A in later cases).

steps.action: In Browser A open http://localhost:3001/sign-in. Under 'Sign in with' choose 'Email', type subject@cmp.local in 'Email address' and click 'Send me a code'. Ask the coordinator for the code, type it in 'Six-digit code' and click 'Verify'.
steps.expected: A 'Check your messages' box appears after the first click. After 'Verify' you are signed in and the 'My consents' page opens; the sidebar shows 'My consents' and 'My requests'.

steps.action: In the sidebar click 'My requests'.
steps.expected: The page 'My requests' opens with the text 'Ask for access to your data, a correction or erasure, or raise a complaint...' and a 'Make a request' button at the top right. At the foot of the page a line says naming someone to act for you is under 'My nominations'.

steps.action: Click 'Make a request'.
steps.expected: A dialog titled 'Make a request' opens with the line 'You are signed in, so this counts as verified and the clock starts now.' It has 'What are you asking for', 'About', 'Your request' and a 'Send the request' button.

steps.action: In 'What are you asking for' choose 'Access (s.11)'.
steps.expected: A blue note under it reads 'A summary of the personal data we hold about you, what we do with it, and who it has been shared with.'

steps.action: Leave 'About' on 'Everything you hold about me'. Type the test text in 'Your request'. Click 'Send the request'.
steps.expected: The dialog closes. A message 'Recorded as RR-YYYY-NNNNNN' appears with 'You will hear from us by <date>.' Write down the reference (RR-A).

steps.action: Look at the new card for RR-A at the top of the list.
steps.expected: The card shows the reference, the badges 'Access · s.11' and 'Received', and the line 'Received <date and time> · you will hear by <date>'. Your request text is shown. There is NO yellow box saying 'We have not yet confirmed this came from you'.

steps.action: Look at the lower half of the card (it opens already expanded after sending).
steps.expected: Two columns are shown: 'Clock' with the checkpoints, and 'The path' with steps including 'Request received', 'Acknowledge', 'Identity verified?', 'A valid access request?' and 'The CMP answers its own records'. The button reads 'Hide progress'.

steps.action: Click 'Hide progress', then 'Show progress'.
steps.expected: The Clock and path collapse and open again.

steps.action: Click 'Show what was recorded' on the card.
steps.expected: A list of recorded events opens, oldest first, starting with the request being received. The button now reads 'Hide what was recorded'.

steps.action: Ask the coordinator to check the outbox for an acknowledgement sent to subject@cmp.local.
steps.expected: An acknowledgement for RR-A is in the outbox, quoting the reference and the date by which she will hear.

pass_criteria: The access request is recorded with an RR- reference, is verified by the session (no 'not yet confirmed' warning), shows 'Received' with its clock and path, and an acknowledgement is sent.
